provenance_notes: Batch base_sha is the checkout revision, not necessarily origin/main. First fixture is preserved by commit 1d44409; focus retry by c39b3fc; final runner by d483924. Source hashes identify on-disk bytes, which may have CRLF before Git normalization.
Raw JSON report values compared against the original 32 files before consolidation; hashes retained. No raw values edited.

derived_engine_simulation_wall_ratio uses all ticks from physics_ticks_per_frame / 60 Hz / sum(frame_time_trace_ms). The original game-clock simulation_wall_ratio starts on the first sampled callback and excludes the first frame interval.
Invalid focus runs and their valid counterparts remain in batches; replacement pairs come from perf-retry. Comparisons refer to complete valid pairs only.
GPU telemetry is the original synchronized window; CPU temperature/effective clocks unavailable. This is exploratory, not five AA/AB 120s pairs or multiplayer acceptance.
